description: Returns a random selection of free Glyfiq icons (name and tags) so you can see what the library covers. Results are drawn randomly from the full free-icon pool, so repeated calls return different icons. The limit parameter controls how many icons are returned (1 to 20, default 10). This is not a search: use search_icons for a specific topic. No license key needed.

limit.description: How many free icons to return (1 to 20, default 10)

name: get_free_icons_sample
title: Get free icons sample
